responsibility: Defines the detailed scheduler model for Samsung Exynos M1. It classifies scalar, NEON, floating-point, crypto, and CRC instructions into Exynos-M1-specific execution categories and assigns reservations and bypasses for issue, integer ALU, load/store, FP/NEON arithmetic, vector memory, crypto, and branch resources, giving the Arm backend a comprehensive microarchitectural timing model for tuning code to this core.
